_comment: cloud-ci-capability-membership gate policy (DATA, not code). Phase-0 capability-first reorg (ADR-0562 §6, the anti-junk-drawer MEMBERSHIP lint — the closed-registry enforcement that makes capability-first safe). The CLOSED capability set + the per-crate mappings + the frozen-unmapped baseline are the single source of truth in specs/capability-registry.json; this policy holds only the gate identity, the registry pointer, the crate-scan roots, the closed meta-directory set, the closed-set top-level-dir whitelist, and the live-corpus crate floor. Born ADVISORY with a frozen baseline: the gate enforces NO REGRESSION (no NEW unmapped crate, no NEW top-level dir outside the closed set) and burns the unmapped baseline DOWN as the strangler homes crates; it flips to BLOCKING when the frozen baseline reaches 0. Born pack-shaped: an adopting repo repoints registry_path + scan_roots + meta_directories; the Rust kernel hardcodes no oyatie path nor any capability slug. SCAN COVERAGE IS DERIVED, NOT HAND-KEPT: `scan_roots` must carry every capability top-level root AND every registry meta directory with owns_crates=true (kernel/os/base/app) — the cross-artifact-agreement registry⇄derived-policy sync check re-derives that requirement from specs/capability-registry.json and REDs on any root dropped here, so a destination root can never fall out of lint coverage silently (a crate-owning root outside `scan_roots` is invisible to the membership lint, and the min_expected_crates floor is a broken-scan guard, NOT a coverage guard).
